data.one_liner: Protect Flutter screens from screenshots, recordings, and unauthorized access.
data.what_it_does: Adds native screen‑capture protection, screenshot/recording detection, biometric re‑authentication, inactivity auto‑lock, integrity checks and a secure clipboard with TTL. It works on Android and iOS via a Flutter plugin.
use_when: Handling confidential or personal data in the UI
Apps that need to prevent screen capture or enforce biometric re‑auth
avoid_when: When targeting platforms other than Android/iOS
When native build‑step complexity is unacceptable
strengths: Full‑screen capture protection on both platforms
Biometric re‑auth and integrity risk detection
Configurable app‑switcher branding and watermark overlay
weaknesses: Requires native configuration (Info.plist entry, FlutterFragmentActivity, specific themes)
Limited to Android and iOS only
Adds runtime overhead for monitoring events
data.setup_notes: Add NSFaceIDUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist; extend Android activity from FlutterFragmentActivity and use an AppCompat theme for API 23‑27; compile with Flutter 3.44+, Android SDK 37, iOS 13+; ensure Swift 6 compiler (Xcode 16).

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides biometric authentication without screen‑capture protection, useful if only auth is needed.
